title: Help center
description: Questions, reports, and emergency help in one place.

question.title: Ask the committee
question.description: Prayer times, events, membership, anything about the mosque.

facility.title: Report a facility issue
facility.description: Toilet, air conditioning, carpet, lights, or anything broken.

suggestion.title: Send a suggestion
suggestion.description: Ideas to make the mosque better. Anonymous is fine.

ustadz.title: Ask an ustadz
ustadz.description: Questions about worship, fiqh, or daily life as a Muslim.

emergency.title: Emergency numbers
emergency.description: 119 ambulance and fire, 110 police, with Japanese phrases to read out.

location.title: Mosque location
location.description: Open in Google Maps for directions.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp the committee
whatsapp.description: Fastest way to reach us during the day.

emergency.title: Emergency in Japan
emergency.description: Calls to 119 and 110 are free from any phone. Stay calm and speak slowly; the operator may switch to an interpreter.
emergency.confirm: Call {number} now? Only use this for a real emergency.

1.ja: 救急車をお願いします。場所は松戸市のアルムッタキーンモスクです。
1.reading: Kyuukyuusha o onegaishimasu. Basho wa Matsudo-shi no Al Muttaqin mosuku desu.
1.meaning: Please send an ambulance. The location is Al Muttaqin Mosque in Matsudo.

2.ja: けが人がいます。意識があります／ありません。
2.reading: Keganin ga imasu. Ishiki ga arimasu / arimasen.
2.meaning: Someone is injured. They are conscious / unconscious.

3.ja: 日本語があまり話せません。英語でお願いします。
3.reading: Nihongo ga amari hanasemasen. Eigo de onegaishimasu.
3.meaning: I do not speak much Japanese. English, please.

emergency.tip: Give the address first, then what happened. If you cannot speak, keep the line open; the operator can trace the call.

placeholders.facility: What is broken, and since when?
placeholders.question: What would you like to know?
placeholders.ustadz: Describe your question. The ustadz will answer privately or in a study circle.
placeholders.website: Which page or feature, and what happened?
placeholders.other: Tell us what is on your mind.

form.name: Name
form.anonymousHint: Leave name and contact empty to send anonymously. Add a contact if you would like a reply.

success.title: Message received
success.body: Thank you. The committee reads every message and replies when a contact is given.

fallback.title: One more step
fallback.body: Online storage is not active yet. Tap the button to send your message on WhatsApp; the text is ready.

whatsapp.title: Message from the Jamaah app - Al Muttaqin
whatsapp.greeting: Assalamu'alaikum, I have a question for the Al Muttaqin committee.
